HAPPENING NOW: President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. visits General Vicente Lim Elementary School, one of the evacuation centers for victims of the Happy Land fire in Tondo, Manila, on Thursday (Sept. 18, 2025).

Marcos led the distribution of cash assistance and relief goods to victims, following the blaze that broke out on Sept. 13, which displaced over 2,000 families in the densely populated community.

Each affected family will receive PHP15,000 in financial aid and family food packs from the DSWD.

The President also vowed to help the victims jn rebuilding their homes. | Darryl John Esguerra

#IntegratedStateMedia
#ISM
#PhilippineNewsAgency
